Workspace settings
Connect your provider

  

  

    
Your key stays on this device. Orbit reuses it after restart until you remove it.

    

    
    
    

    

          
Fetching the list and testing a model are separate on purpose: a provider can refuse /models while your chosen model answers fine, and a listed model is not proof it generates. Testing sends one small live request to the model named above and may cost a fraction of a cent.

    
Brings the Arena tab forward and watches for your Google sign-in to finish. One-time — the tab is remembered.

    
    
    
Arena tab relay — experimental, no API key. Arena’s Terms prohibit automated access without permission; a free account or low usage does not grant permission. Use an authorized API provider for reliable autonomous agents. If Arena permits your use, sign in and review any Terms yourself in Orbit’s dedicated tab, then Fetch models → choose a model → Test connection → Save connection. Orbit brings the relay tab forward during requests and returns replies once generation finishes. Prompts, instructions and attached page text are sent to Arena and use your daily credits. Text only — images, screenshots, hosted tools and API generation settings are unsupported. Orbit never accepts legal terms or solves sign-in challenges for you.

  

  

    
    
    
    
    

    
    
Page context is opt-in and only sent when you submit a message. Agent and research runs propose steps; every consequential step waits for your approval.

    
    
    

      What Orbit has learned
      
Durable facts a supervised task saved through the approval gate. Nothing is added silently: each one was shown to you at the step it was saved, and they are sent to your provider as attributed data, never as instructions. Confirm to keep them working, or forget them.

      

    

  

  

    
A persona is a name, a colour and standing instructions. The roster keeps each kind of work in its own voice without cloning your key: every persona asks the same provider, and an optional model override changes only which model answers.

    

    

    
Address a persona in the composer with @name to have it answer without switching. Orbit also accepts a click on its avatar in the roster.

  

  

    
A routine is a prompt that comes back on its own. Chrome wakes Orbit when the time is due; if no Orbit surface is open, the run happens the next time you open one. Nothing runs in the background.
